protocol.competitor: locally smooth same-force zero-datum field with a uniform L2 bound on every fixed preterminal interval; no pressure decay or global derivative bound
protocol.limit: fix T<1, send R to infinity, then approach the protected core; no uniform constants as T approaches one are required
protocol.object: the exact conditional Q9 finite-energy field, complete fixed-gauge pressure and compact smooth force with zero datum
protocol.obstruction: the Q8 all-fixed-order punctured endpoint inequality and every upstream Q1-Q8 continuum contract remain conditional
protocol.pressure: retain -div(f) in both individual pressure equations, cancel the common force once, and use momentum plus finite energy to remove the harmonic pressure-gradient ambiguity
protocol.radius: use the compact mixed pressure, L^(4/3) quadratic commutator, eighth-power cutoff and all remainders through the limiting R^-2 term
protocol.scope: conditional Q10 pressure recovery, comparison and finite-energy competitor exclusion only; no future solution or unconditional admissible-force, exclusion or blow-up theorem

remaining_obligations: prove the Q8 punctured endpoint inequality and every still-conditional Q1-Q8 provider contract
audit the complete current-head dependency graph and quantify the exact remaining analytical primitives
do not promote conditional same-force comparison or exclusion to an unconditional admissible-force or blow-up theorem

review.blocking_inequality: sup_(E x [1-delta,1)) |D_x^alpha partial_t^j(A,B,p)|<infinity for every fixed alpha,j

conditional_conclusion.comparison: v=u on R^3 x [0,T] for every fixed T<1
conditional_conclusion.exclusion: a globally smooth locally bounded finite-energy same-force competitor is excluded relative to every frozen Q1-Q10 contract
conditional_conclusion.pressure_gradient: grad(P-p)=grad sum_ij R_i R_j(v_i v_j-u_i u_j)

interface.competitor: v,P locally smooth, same f and zero datum, sup_[0,T] ||v||_2 finite for every T<1
interface.constructed: exact Q9 u=curl(cA)+cB, p=cp0, compact smooth f, zero datum and finite energy
interface.no_added_hypotheses: no global competitor derivative, pressure-decay or dissipation bound

limit.Gronwall: E_R(t)<=2 C_T T exp(2 T L_T) R^-2 for each fixed T<1
limit.Q9_limit_order: fix T<1, recover pressure, send R to infinity, then approach the protected core

current_core.path: z=0, r=sqrt(2 X_in tau), q=tau, eta=0, X=X_in

limit.limit_order: fix T<1, then R->infinity, then approach the protected core as t->1
limit.localized_inequality: 0.5 E_R'(t)+0.5 D_R(t)^2<=||grad u(t)||_infinity E_R(t)+C_T R^-2; E_R(0)=0

pressure.Q9_interface: u,p,f have Q9 finite energy; v,P have the same f and zero datum and a fixed-interval L2 bound
pressure.harmonic_counterexample: without finite energy, v=t e1 and P=-x1 versus u=0,p=0 have the same zero datum and force but a nonzero harmonic pressure gradient
pressure.individual_pressures: -Delta p=partial_i partial_j(u_i u_j)-div f; -Delta P=partial_i partial_j(v_i v_j)-div f
pressure.recovery: pi_star=sum R_i R_j g_ij in L_infinity_t H^-2; for every compact time test, grad(pi-pi_star) is harmonic in H^-3 and hence zero
pressure.stress: g=v tensor v-u tensor u=w tensor w+w tensor u+u tensor w

radius.compact_mixed_pressure: |pi_h|<=C H_T R^-3 and its annular flux is O(R^-5/2)
radius.cutoff: chi_R=phi(x/R)^8; phi=1 on B_1 and zero outside B_2
radius.support_split: g=w tensor w+h; h=w tensor u+u tensor w; supp h subset K
